title: An AI-Based System Has Found a Potential Longevity Drug

fields.headline: An AI-Based System Has Found a Potential Longevity Drug
fields.sourceHeadline: “An AI-Based System Has Found a Potential Longevity Drug”
fields.note: Featuring ClockBase Agent and ouabain discovery.

excerpt.text: To that end, these researchers created ClockBase Agent, which uses over two million human and murine samples, including both RNA sequencing and epigenetic measurements, and 40 separate aging clocks.
